subject.title: Add Message Rate Limiting for Feishu Channel

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Feishu-owned, default-off `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing?
rationale: Source inspection shows the gap, but adding a new operator-facing Feishu config key and deciding the proof bar for live delivery timing require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96513 or a replacement toward default-off per-account/per-target Feishu send pacing across burstable sends.

options.title: Keep Only Reactive Retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on existing Feishu retry/backoff after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Move Scope To Broad Limiter
options.body: Defer Feishu-specific pacing and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13615 own any cross-provider queueing or rate-limit policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96513 or a replacement toward default-off per-account/per-target Feishu send pacing across burstable sends.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned send behavior.
